gloss: Humble and open-minded, like a valley.
teaser: Today, we explore the beauty of humility in a powerful idiom.
script: Welcome to Chengyu Bites — your quick summary on Chinese 成语. Today, we explore the beauty of humility in a powerful idiom. [break 1s] The phrase is: 虚怀若谷, xū huái ruò gǔ. [break 1s] 虚 (xū) - empty, void [break 0.5s] 怀 (huái) - heart, mind [break 0.5s] 若 (ruò) - like, as if [break 0.5s] 谷 (gǔ) - valley [break 1s] So, 虚怀若谷 literally means 'empty heart like a valley,' and figuratively, it describes someone who is humble and open-minded. [break 1s] Here’s the story behind it: [break 1.5s] In ancient times, a wise teacher was known for his vast knowledge yet remained very humble. One day, a student asked him how he could be so knowledgeable. The teacher pointed to a deep valley and said, 'Just as this valley is open to receive all the rain, we too must be open to learn from everyone around us.' This wisdom became the foundation of the idiom. [break 1.5s] Example 1: 他总是虚怀若谷，愿意听取别人的意见。 [break 1s] He is always humble and willing to listen to others' opinions. [break 1s] Example 2: 虚怀若谷是成功人士的重要特质。 [break 1s] Humility is an important trait of successful people. [break 1s] Example 3: 我们应该虚怀若谷，学习他人的优点。 [break 1s] We should be humble and learn from the strengths of others. [break 1s] So, remember 虚怀若谷, which means being humble and open-minded, like a valley. Thank you for listening to Chengyu Bites! See you next time for another idiom. [break 1s]
